full_judgment:
Latifur Rahman J : This appeal by leave at the instance of the plaintiff is directed against the judgment of the High Court Division, Sylhet Bench, passed in Second Appeal No. 906 of 1968 allowing the appeal and setting aside the judgment and decree of the first appellate court reversing the judgment and decree of the trial court arising out of a suit for declaration of title and recovery of khas possession. 

 6. The plaintiff sought for declaration on the basis of the deed of gift Ext. 5 and consequently, the main question for decision is whether the deed of gift is valid and on that basis the plaintiff can seek for declaration of title and recovery of the khas possession.
